description: Configure conversion page patterns per Frontend application. Only users with app-settings write permissions can modify these settings.

name.description: A label for this conversion configuration (e.g. 'Sizzling Pubs Conversions')

applicationId.description: The dt.entity.rum_application entity ID this config applies to (e.g. APPLICATION-ABC123)

conversionPatterns.description: URL path keywords that indicate a conversion (e.g. 'checkout', 'payment', 'thank-you'). A session visiting any page containing one of these patterns counts as converted.
